clips.title: The story
paras: Vol'jin is the chieftain of the Darkspear trolls and a master shadow hunter. Residing in Grommash Hold alongside Warchief Thrall, he acts as a trusted advisor to the Horde while working to secure his displaced people a permanent home in Durotar.

Vol'jin took up leadership of the Darkspear tribe following the tragic death of his father, Sen'jin, on their ancestral island home. When sea witch-worshipping murlocs and human forces nearly destroyed the isolated tribe, Thrall's orcs intervened, forging a deep bond between the two peoples. After evacuating the ruins of their islands, Vol'jin pledged his trolls to the New Horde and brought them across the Great Sea to Kalimdor.
